tools.name: ask_seller
tools.description: Ask one question about a listing before your user decides: availability, condition, what is included, timing, location, sizes, how delivery or pickup works. If the seller has their assistant (Ego) answering (seller.answers_questions is true in search results), the answer comes back in this response,

tools.name: check_request
tools.description:
Check a request made with request_order or message_seller: the confirm link and, once there is one, the order it led to (order has its title, quantity, amount and deadlines). Returns the confirm_url again. status is one of:
- pending: Your user hasn't confirmed or declined yet. Nothing has happened:

tools.name: message_seller
tools.description: Send a message to the seller of a listing as your user: a question Ego couldn't answer, a custom request, or whether a sold-out listing will be back. tools.name: pay_order
tools.description: Pay for an order made with request_order without the confirm page, using a Stripe Shared Payment Token that your user approved (for example in Stripe Link). request_order returns payment: the amount per unit in USD, max_quantity and payment_handlers with the Stripe network_id to issue the token to;

tools.name: request_order
tools.description: Start an order for one listing on your user's behalf. Returns a confirm_url: your user opens it, checks the listing and price, enters an email address and pays on Egonex (payments are processed by Stripe). tools.name: search_offers
tools.description:
Search listings on Egonex, a marketplace where individual people sell things and services directly. Use it when your user wants to buy, hire, book, rent or commission something from a person rather than a store, for example:
- items, new or used: cameras and lenses, phones, laptops, bikes, furniture

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "search_offers" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ask_seller, check_request, message_seller, pay_order, search_offers · Private data: check_request, pay_order, search_offers · Public sink: ask_seller, check_request, message_seller, pay_order, request_order, search_offers · Destructive: pay_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ask_seller, check_request, message_seller, pay_order, search_offers · Private data: check_request, pay_order, search_offers · Public sink: ask_seller, check_request, message_seller, pay_order, request_order, search_offers · Destructive: pay_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
